## License-conflict quarantine

### Osirion Verse Samples

`OsirionGG/Verse-Samples`

Reviewed tree: `01d11625afd8f7a5ef99c111e1291678b40475d8`

The repository's `LICENSE` file contains Apache License 2.0, while its README currently says MIT.
Because those two statements conflict, V12 keeps this repository `reference-only` until upstream clarifies the intended license.
